role: Builder: about, timeline, team, FAQ, register
one_line_verdict: Honest, on-brand and well structured, and the facts come from config with matching static fallbacks. Not yet 9-level: the hackathon section is long, the closing band has no action a visitor can take today, and there are a few copy and emphasis nits.
top_remaining_issue: Every 'How to register' CTA lands on a band that offers nothing to do yet: there is no notify link and no contact email, and 'Contact email coming soon' shows in both the band and the footer. The client must supply at least a contact email before launch. Two smaller issues are ours to fix. My .rg-line [data-fact] rule now bolds the config-driven 'Discord' in the band's first sentence, which is odd emphasis. The relocated 'Why a hackathon, not a coding contest' subheading brings back the 'not X' construction the round-1 review asked us to remove.
